3.source: Rewritten 2026-11-22 fresh from the public-domain King James Version (the earlier text was a loose paraphrase), checked against the Hebrew, at a simple, Deaf-friendly reading level with hard KJV words explained in parentheses, and no sentence over 14 words. V10 keeps the KJV's God repented of the evil, explained in parentheses.

verses.text: And the word of the LORD came to Jonah the 2nd time, saying:
Arise (get up), go to Nineveh, that great city. And preach to it the preaching that I bid (tell) you.
So Jonah arose (got up), and went to Nineveh. He did it according to the word of the LORD. Now Nineveh was an exceeding (very) great city of 3 days' journey (to walk across).
And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey. And he cried, and said: Yet 40 days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown (destroyed).

So the people of Nineveh believed God. They proclaimed a fast (announced a time of no eating). And they put on sackcloth (rough cloth worn in sorrow). They did it from the greatest of them even to the least of them.
For word came to the king of Nineveh. And he arose (got up) from his throne, and he laid his robe from him. He covered himself with sackcloth (rough cloth worn in sorrow), and sat in ashes.

And the king caused it to be proclaimed and published (announced) through Nineveh. It was by the decree (law) of the king and his nobles (important men), saying: Let neither man nor beast (animal) taste any thing. Let not the herd nor flock feed, nor drink water.

But let man and beast (animal) be covered with sackcloth (rough cloth worn in sorrow). Let them cry mightily to God. Yes, let them turn every one from his evil way. Let them turn from the violence that is in their hands.
Who can tell if God will turn and repent (change His mind)? Who can tell if He will turn away from His fierce anger? Then we would not perish (die).
And God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way. And God repented of the evil (did not bring the trouble). It was the evil He had said He would do to them. And He did it not.
